_comment: United Arab Emirates. Only exemptions (docs/17-action-items.md A11).

exemptions.reason: Etihad Rail is a mixed freight and conventional passenger line: the passenger trains run at up to 200 km/h on a freight main line (design maxspeed=200), which is the high-speed floor but not high-speed rail; the Abu Dhabi-Dubai 350 km/h project is not built. The Al Gharbia Main Line (Ghuweifat-Ruwais) is a freight line.
